title: Program Integrity
supports: DHS reports Minnesota Medicaid paid $20.9 billion to providers in 2024.
DHS reports more than $56 million identified for recovery since 2020.
DHS reports 3,587 high-risk providers revalidated, 1,177 appealing disenrollment, 128 voluntary terminations, and 695 terminations after appeal windows closed, updated September 8, 2026.
DHS identifies 14 Medicaid service provider types as high-risk and describes enhanced screening, revalidation, pre-payment review and onsite visits.
important_qualifications: Identified for recovery is not the same as cash recovered.
Provider revalidation and review counts measure implementation activity; they do not by themselves establish that controls are effective at reducing fraud or improper payments.
High-risk is an oversight designation, not a finding that a provider or service is fraudulent.
